deviation: Assignment of Deliverables only happens "upon payment", so Arcadia would not own bespoke deliverables during a fee dispute. "Helix Materials" is also broader than pre-existing tools, because it covers anything "developed independently of the Services". This could let Helix carve bespoke work out of Arcadia's ownership. The licence is also not irrevocable and does not cover modification or Affiliates.
suggested_text:
7.1 Customer Data. As between the Parties, Arcadia owns all right, title and interest in Arcadia Data and its pre-existing materials.

7.2 Deliverables. Helix hereby assigns to Arcadia, with effect from creation, all right, title and interest in the Deliverables, excluding Helix Materials. Ownership of the Deliverables is not conditional on payment.

7.3 Helix Materials. Helix retains ownership of its tools, methodologies and materials that existed before the Effective Date and that were not created specifically for Arcadia or funded by Arcadia ("Helix Materials"). Anything created specifically for Arcadia under the Services is a Deliverable and not Helix Materials. To the extent Helix Materials are incorporated in a Deliverable, Helix grants Arcadia and its Affiliates a non-exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, copy, modify and maintain them as part of the Deliverable.
